nieuw.titel: Hide random movers behind hills to threaten unseen targets
nieuw.tekst: Consider hiding a random-movement unit behind a hill that blocks line of sight, then moving over it into an enemy unit. He suggests this can threaten several targets and potentially control a whole flank without first exposing the unit to shooting.
nieuw.waarom: He explains that the hill hides the unit from some shooting while random movement lets it reach targets it cannot see. In his view, its variable movement range can threaten opponents whether they advance or stay back.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He positioned his Spawn behind the central hill and rolled high enough to choose between several enemy units, even though his opponent stayed back.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He stresses that his high movement rolls were lucky and that the unit must still obey its other normal movement rules.

bronnen.citaat: if you're carrying around items with random movement

extraCitaten.citaat: think about hiding it behind a Terrain feature such as a hill
it is being hidden from some of the shooting by the rules of the hill

nieuw.titel: Use the Spawn against enemies that want to flee
nieuw.tekst: He has found the Gigantic Spawn of Chaos most useful for entering combats against enemies that would want to flee from a normal charge. Use its random movement to deny that charge reaction.
nieuw.waarom: He explains that an opponent cannot make that charge reaction against the Spawn's random movement as it could against an otherwise declared charge.

bronnen.citaat: with its random movement into combats where the opponent might want to fled and can't
